The request itself is not a ground truth." [2026-08-05] MUSIC QUALITY BAR, for anyone generating background music: (1) LOUDNESS-MATCH beds or every cross-fade is a volume jump — measure BS.1770, do not eyeball. Careful: deriving K-weighting from RBJ cookbook formulas does NOT reproduce the standard (shelf 0.2577 dB low at 997 Hz = exactly how far the calibration tone then misses -3.01 LKFS); round-trip the tabulated 48k coefficients through their analog prototype. (2) SEARCH for loop points (spectral+level match, beat-snapped) — generated music never loops sample-perfect. (3) Ask for a tempo but MEASURE it, and expect autocorrelation to return a multiple (2x for night, 3/2x for title) — use the brief's BPM as a prior. (4) Generate lossless, master once, encode at the end. (5) Naming real IP/artists is a 400 ToS block; negative prompts backfire; say 'it starts immediately' or you get a fade-in the maintainer will reject.
